metadata.title: Customer Segmentation & RFM Analytics Executive Portal
metadata.author: Austin Ajay

segments.name: Champions
segments.description: Recent, highly frequent buyers who spend significantly more than average.
segments.action: Reward loyalty with VIP perks, early product releases, personalized concierge service, and referral incentives.

segments.name: Loyal
segments.description: Consistent repeat customers who purchase regularly with strong spending power.
segments.action: Offer loyalty program tier progressions, cross-sell premium complementary categories, and request product reviews.

segments.name: At Risk
segments.description: Historically high-spending customers who haven’t purchased in 12+ months.
segments.action: Deploy dedicated churn prevention playbook: deep discount recovery offers, direct executive check-in, or re-marketing ads.

segments.name: New Customers
segments.description: Bought very recently but have only 1 or 2 purchases so far.
segments.action: Trigger an automated welcome nurture sequence, share top-selling product guides, and offer a second-purchase coupon.

segments.name: Need Attention
segments.description: Above-average past activity, but have not made a purchase in over 6-8 months.
segments.action: Send personalized re-engagement campaigns with limited-time reactivation discounts and customer satisfaction check-ins.

segments.name: About to Sleep
segments.description: Made only 1 purchase long ago and will churn permanently if not engaged promptly.
segments.action: Target with aggressive win-back deals, re-introduce popular seasonal products, and survey for lost interest reasons.

segments.name: Potential
segments.description: Recent frequent buyers with lower average order values.
segments.action: Incentivize higher basket size with minimum spend discounts (e.g., £20 off £100) and product bundle recommendations.
